==Skin Trivia==
*The '''Sentry's''' design was based on ''Team Fortress 2's'' BLU [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Sentry_Gun Sentry Gun].
*The original appearance of the '''Sentry''' had smooth faces, and there were some developmental images with this smooth face mesh. However, for the release of the '''Sentry''', it had flat faces.
*Originally, during the development of the '''Sentry''', there were only three distinctive models to coincide with Levels 0-2, 3-4 and 5. This would have been the same progression of visual changes made to the Default [[Turret]] at the time.
**However, BelowNatural would later add a fourth distinctive model, a definitive Level 5 upgrade.
***Earlier developmental images of the '''Sentry''' would show the previous progression, with a Level 4 model having a teddy bear as part of its cosmetics. This would later become a defining feature of the Level 5 model.
*The '''Sentry''' used to have a 30% chance to receive a teddy bear at Level 5, which gave it hidden detection. After the 5th of August 2019, however, the '''Sentry''' gained hidden detection at Level 5 regardless of whether it had the teddy bear or not.
**The chance to get the teddy bear was removed on the 13th of October 2019.
**A teddy bear has a low chance to appear on an [[Engineer]]'s [[War Machine Sentry]], being a reference to this.

===Roblox Catalog===
*The teddy bear that had a chance to appear on the Level 5 '''Sentry''' is the {{RLinkC|12848902|Teddy Bloxpin}} gear from the Roblox Catalog.
